records.coverage: Only streetlights maintained by EESL under an applicable local project; not every streetlight in India
records.description: EESL publishes a consumer complaint channel for its projects. Confirm the streetlight operator with the local body before using this channel.
steps: Check whether the affected streetlight belongs to an EESL-maintained project.
Report the precise street, landmark and pole identifier if known, with the observed problem and duration.
Save the complaint reference and use EESL's grievance route if the regular complaint remains unresolved.
conditions: For another operator's streetlight, use the responsible municipality or operator's channel. Selecting a state does not establish EESL coverage.

contactPhone.purpose: EESL project complaints; confirm the asset is maintained by EESL

records.coverage: Streetlights maintained by Greater Chennai Corporation within its jurisdiction
records.description: GCC's Electrical Department installs and maintains its streetlights. Use the municipal complaint system to report a non-burning light.
steps: Describe the streetlight fault with the street, landmark and pole number if available.
Submit through GCC's complaint system or call its published complaint number.
Keep the complaint reference when following up with the electrical department.

contactPhone.purpose: Greater Chennai Corporation complaints within GCC jurisdiction

contactEmail.purpose: Electrical department correspondence and follow-up; use the complaint portal to obtain a reference

conditions: This is a Chennai municipal channel, not a statewide Tamil Nadu streetlight service.

records.department: Central Pollution Control Board — SAMEER app
records.coverage: Air-pollution complaints in Delhi-NCR; only NCR areas of Haryana, Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan, not those entire states
records.description: CPCB's published citizen guide describes SAMEER complaint submission and tracking for air pollution in Delhi-NCR, including observed dust sources.
steps: Confirm that the pollution location is in Delhi-NCR and register in the SAMEER app.
Choose Public Complaint, check the detected location and select the appropriate category.
Add the observed details and a photo, submit, then save the complaint ID for tracking.
conditions: This is an air-pollution channel, not a general noise complaint service.
The published complaint coverage is Delhi-NCR. Air-quality readings elsewhere do not establish local complaint coverage.
